content.text: Digital [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-how-creators-ghana-get-paid-online-complete|COREMERCH guide to creators]] in Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, and other regions where Stripe, PayPal, and Gumroad are unavailable or severely restricted face a significant challenge: how to sell ebooks and digital products without relying on these platforms. In Zimbabwe, for instance, the government's crackdown on foreign exchange and currency restrictions made it impossible for creators to collect payments through conventional means. This is where [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/full-infrastructure-guide-tron-usdt-payments-digital-products|The Full]] sovereignty comes in – [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/building-crypto-store-cloudflare-pages-step-step-deployment-2|building]] a bespoke online store on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, integrating automatic crypto payment processing with NOWPayments, and ensuring full data ownership. By doing so, creators can break free from platform fees, currency restrictions, and the risk of having their stores shut down without warning.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto-explained-digital-creators-2. Gumroad charges 10% on every sale, which translates to a significant loss for creators who sell digital products regularly. For instance, at 100 sales per month on a $97 product, the fee difference between Gumroad and NOWPayments would retain $921. This is a substantial amount that creators can use to invest in their businesses or reinvest in their products. Moreover, NOWPayments charges just 0.5% on every transaction, making it an attractive option for creators who want to maximize their earnings.
What You Need Before You Deploy

To set up a sovereign digital commerce stack, you'll need a few essential tools: GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery, and NOWPayments for automatic crypto payment verification. Make sure you have these tools in place before proceeding with the deployment process.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

To set up your payment and delivery pipeline, you'll need to integrate NOWPayments with your store's backend logic. This involves setting up a webhook that fires the moment a payment confirms on-chain, and then using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to automate the delivery of digital products to customers. You can also configure your store to use a cryptocurrency of your choice, such as Bitcoin, Ethereum, or USDT, to accept payments from customers worldwide.
Sovereign digital commerce stacks provide creators with full control over their infrastructure and data.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once you've set up your payment and delivery pipeline, it's time to go live. This involves deploying your store on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, and configuring your store's settings to accept payments and deliver digital products to customers. You'll also need to test your store thoroughly to ensure that everything is working as expected. After going live, you can start processing transactions and delivering digital products to your customers.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

Scaling your sovereign digital commerce stack is crucial to maximizing your earnings and growing your business. This involves monitoring your store's performance, optimizing your backend logic and payment pipeline, and using tools like the Complete Builder Kit to streamline your deployment process. By scaling your infrastructure, you can ensure that your store remains secure, fast, and reliable, even as your business grows.

The answer is yes. With NOWPayments and a properly set up payment and delivery pipeline, you can trust that your transactions will be processed securely and that your digital products will be delivered to customers on time. This is why creators choose to build their online stores on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages – for the peace of mind that comes with having full control over their infrastructure and data. By doing so, they can focus on creating high-quality digital products and marketing their stores to customers worldwide.
